in_hebrew.name: Dare
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Daring, brave, fearless
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Dare הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'dare,' meaning 'to be bold' or 'to dare.' In Greek mythology, Dares was the name of a Trojan prince, known for his bravery. In Christianity, the name Dare can represent the courage and faith to take on challenges and follow one's beliefs.

in_latin.name: Dare
in_latin.meaning: Nomen significans fidem aut fiduciam habentem
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen significans fidem aut fiduciam habentem. Videtur ex Graece derivatum. Usus est in nomine Sancti Dare, quod in historia Ecclesiae occidentalis non invenitur. Fidelitas et fiducia sunt virtutes Christi et Ecclesiae.
